focus.evidence: Native dialogs focus Close and restore triggers/Account in checked live paths. Visible focus on every interactive element in both themes and all states is not established.

contrast.evidence: Parent r4-wasm-node.txt includes the active-palette check; source vendor hashes pass. No full computed-style text/control/focus/state measurement matrix for every shipped theme was performed. Apparent screenshot contrast is only a quality observation.

states.evidence: 52 originals cover unconfigured/empty, sparse audit and open unsubmitted forms. Parent tests exercise configured pairing/revoke, persisted settings, invalid topology and hostile ledger strings. All per-task loading/error/announced validation/populated states are not independently captured and reviewed.
